objective: Net excess Sharpe>=2 and CAGR>10percent, with realistic marked financing and borrow
signal: Trailing126-session z-score of log class-price ratio, enter against deviation at abs(z)>=2, exit abs(z)<=0.5 or sign crossover or after30 sessions. Hold entry units, no repeated rebalancing while holding. No beta fit; equal USD long/short within pair. Known voting/liquidity differences mean no guaranteed convergence.
selection: 2015-2020 ranks individual pairs only; FOX has a short development history and remains descriptive if less than3years. The primary candidate is a fixed one-third allocation to each pair, independent of individual performance. Cash allocation for pair not yet eligible.
sizing: Primary book total gross2 when all three pairs active: one-third NAV long and one-third short per pair. Individual diagnostics gross2. Fixed capital fractions, daily mark-to-market. No leverage parameter sweep.
financing: Only cash minus marked short-sale collateral earns RF. If negative, finance deficit at RF+1percent. RF is French daily RF. Short collateral receives no interest rebate; accrue borrow on marked short exposure. Costs and financing are deducted from daily marked NAV. Adjusted total-return prices proxy dividends and splits.
execution: Signal at close, next-open fill, both legs atomic if either entry open missing; missing mark or exit on held position fails. Exit costs included on final day. Source cache adjusted OHLC; no venue quotes or borrow locates.
gate: Primary book evaluation excess Sharpe>=2 and CAGR>10percent, stress excess mean>0, positive excess mean each complete2021-2024year, centered20day bootstrap primary mean p<.05. Three pair diagnostics never determine primary construction. No virgin holdout claim.
limitations: Same-issuer voting differences, liquidity premium and permanent spread shifts
Cache backfills GOOG before Class C listing; all Alphabet data before2014-04-03 must be excluded
Proxy financing and borrow rates, unverified availability
Current surviving issuer choice and previously seen macro dates
No fixed data cost, taxes, ticket minimums or empirical market impact
